attributes.board_name: Nebraska DHHS Licensure Unit – Board of Veterinary Medicine and Surgery

rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved continuing competency: state/national/district veterinary or vet-tech association meetings (NVMA, AVMA, AAHA, AAEP …), formal education and courses of accredited veterinary/vet-tech colleges, AAVSB RACE-approved programs, Board-approved activities; specialty board (re)certification meets the entire requirement
rules.alternatives: Initial board certification or re-certification by an AVMA-recognized veterinary specialty organization during the renewal period meets the entire continuing competency requirement.

topics.who: Veterinarians who prescribe controlled substances; 0.5 h of the 3 h must cover the Prescription Drug Monitoring Program (PDMP)

rules.legal_basis: 172 NAC 180-005 and 180-006; Neb. Rev. Stat. §38-145 (controlled substances)
rules.notes: All licenses expire April 1 of even-numbered years. Home-study courses (with provider-scored test) and practice management each max 1/4 of required hours. The 3 opioid hours count within the 32.
